302.description: The browser is redirected to the Google authorization flow.

get.description: A provider callback: Google redirects the browser back here after authorization, and the response is the token pair as JSON. A documentation client cannot complete it, because the provider supplies the authorization result. The request is authenticated by the provider after it verifies the authorization, not by a bearer access token.

200.description: The provider authentication is verified, and a token pair is issued.

401.description: The provider authentication failed, or the provider email cannot be safely linked.

TransitionalIdentityErrorDto.description: Transitional, framework-generated error body of the Identity operations. It describes what the framework produces today and is not the stable application error envelope: message may be a string or an array of strings, error may be absent, and statusCode carries the HTTP status. Clients must not branch on message.

email.description: The email address to register. It must be a valid email.

password.description: The account password, with a minimum length of 8.

displayName.description: The name shown to other users. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed first; the limits apply after trimming, so the trimmed value must not be blank and has at most 50 Unicode code points.
